text: No single set of writing principles serves all organizational genres.
The humanize skill's Pass 1 instruction to force claims that commit is a defect in genres where the honest epistemic state is uncertainty.
The humanize skill's scientific-papers override scopes the calibration fix too narrowly, because the same problem occurs in organizational decision genres beyond academic writing.
ASD-STE100 actively damages persuasive force because it removes the rhetorical devices persuasion depends on.
Incident notification and postmortem are the same event written in incompatible registers, and no single technique in the available set handles both.
Optimizing writing against readability-formula scores is a Goodhart failure: the scores are valid diagnostics but invalid optimization targets.
Amazon's narrative memo format and its ban on bullets constitutes a rival theory of clarity to compression-based approaches, not merely a stylistic preference.
Amazon's claim that full prose exposes muddled thinking better than bullets lacks controlled experimental evidence and rests on institutional adoption and practitioner testimony.
Status update honesty degrades at each hierarchical summarization hop, and writing craft can address only part of this problem because incentive structures are outside craft's reach.
A mechanical surface audit cannot reliably distinguish a weasel word from a genuine confidence interval or calibrated qualifier.

The 'more committed is generally better' heuristic is the same Goodhart shape as 'shorter is generally better', valid for personal-voice publishing and invalid as a universal target for organizational decision writing.

Incident notification while facts are still moving is the genre most underserved by all available techniques, requiring a dedicated uncertainty-preserving schema with mandatory known/unknown/next-update fields.
ISO 24495-1 plain language is the only technique in the set that scores non-negative across all ten considerations, making it a safe substrate for other techniques.
The blameless postmortem convention handles postmortem register well but damages incident notification by encouraging premature causation.
The three Claude writing skills (ste, plainspoken, humanize) are not a coherent toolkit but three tools for three different problems with conflicting assumptions.

Brevity and durability are in structural tension: genres requiring extreme brevity (incident notification, status update) and genres requiring durability (decision record, postmortem) demand opposite structural choices.
ASD-STE100 damages confidence calibration because its controlled vocabulary and tense restrictions remove hedges and complex tense forms needed to express uncertainty.
STE's accessibility benefits for second-language readers rest on institutional adoption and design intent rather than controlled comprehension studies against alternatives.
Toulmin argumentation is the technique best suited to dissent because it is the only one that scores well on both persuasive force and confidence calibration simultaneously.

Reference and onboarding documentation is the genre best served by STE-style controlled language because its reader model (consulted, not read through; L2-accessible; lookup-oriented) most closely matches STE's design assumptions.
The Amazon six-page memo format actively damages scannability and brevity because its design requires continuous prose and prohibits bullets.
Decision records require durability and reasoning legibility for absent future readers, making raw brevity the wrong optimization target for that genre.
The Minto Pyramid Principle's answer-first structure can force false closure in uncertainty-heavy genres where the honest answer is still provisional.

The controlled experimental evidence base for most organizational writing techniques is sparse; institutional adoption and practitioner consensus dominate, and direct links to decision outcomes are largely absent.
The humanize skill's coefficient-of-variation sentence-rhythm target (CV > 0.4) is a number chosen empirically rather than derived from evidence.
Scannability and durability are in structural tension because bullet-and-heading structures that aid lookup actively damage the connective reasoning that makes a document legible to future readers.
